descricao_original: Small lymphatic capillaries anastomose to form larger lymphatic vessels that possess smooth muscle in their wall. Oriented circularly around the lumen, the smooth muscle aids in propelling lymph through the system. The outer layer of the vessel consists of an adventitia composed of connective tissue. 200x (l); 600x (r).
